title: A robot cell builds a 555 blinker
summary: The X_eTaL assembly cell, simulated in the browser, builds a whole 555 LED blinker: the chip in the vise, jumpers between its legs, each resistor and capacitor bent, laid along its pin, soldered and trimmed, the light, the battery snap, and a check against the netlist. At about four times speed, the whole UI showing.

scenes.heading: A robot cell builds a 555 blinker
lines: Simulated in the browser, at four times speed

scenes.heading: The assembly cell
scenes.narration: This is a simulated robot assembly bench. It has one arm, a turntable with a vise and pincers, an iron that feeds its own {solder|sodder}, a tool rack, and a tray of parts. The arm brings a {lead|leed} to a {lead|leed}. A pincer holds it, and the turntable brings the joint to the iron. Watch it build a whole blinker circuit, at four times speed.

scenes.heading: The chip into the vise
scenes.narration: The arm takes its tweezers. It picks the chip, and sets it in the vise, legs up.

scenes.heading: Jumper: pin 8 to pin 4
scenes.narration: First, a jumper from pin eight to pin four. An enameled wire is fed and cut. The arm lays it across the legs, and a pincer holds it. The turntable brings each end to the iron. Touch, feed {solder|sodder}, and cool.

scenes.heading: Jumper: pin 6 to pin 2
scenes.narration: The second jumper joins pin six to pin two, laid over the first. It is pinched, and {soldered|soddered} at both ends. Each joint is inspected as it cools.

scenes.heading: The first resistor, on pin 8
scenes.narration: Now the parts. The arm picks the first resistor, and puts it in the rig. The rig bends its {lead|leed} at a right angle, and the shear cuts it short. The {lead|leed} is laid along pin eight, pinched, and {soldered|soddered}. Then the cutter trims the other {lead|leed}.

scenes.heading: Jumper: the first resistor to pin 7
scenes.narration: Next, a jumper with lapped ends runs from the first resistor to pin seven, the discharge pin. It is brought in from the side, so the tweezers clear the {leads|leeds} around it.

scenes.heading: The second resistor, on pin 6
scenes.narration: The second resistor follows the same steps. Into the rig, bend, and shear. Lay its {lead|leed} along pin six. Pinch it, {solder|sodder} it, and let it cool. Then trim the free {lead|leed} at the cutter.

scenes.heading: Jumper: the second resistor to pin 7
scenes.narration: Then a jumper joins the second resistor to pin seven. Each end is laid along its {lead|leed}, and pinched. The turntable brings it to the iron, and it is {soldered|soddered}. The joint cools before the pincer lets go.

scenes.heading: The third resistor, on pin 3
scenes.narration: The third resistor goes on pin three, the output. After the trim, a pincer bends its free end straight up, ready for the light.

scenes.heading: The disc capacitor, on pin 5
scenes.narration: The small disc capacitor needs no bending. Its {lead|leed} is lowered from above onto pin five, and {soldered|soddered}.

scenes.heading: Ground: the disc capacitor to pin 1
scenes.narration: A ground jumper runs from the disc capacitor, over the chip, to pin one. It goes in before the next capacitor stands over pin two.

scenes.heading: The electrolytic capacitor, on pin 2
scenes.narration: The electrolytic capacitor is lowered onto pin two. Its {lead|leed} is pinched against the leg, and {soldered|soddered}.

scenes.heading: Ground: the capacitor to pin 1
scenes.narration: Ground again. A jumper runs from the electrolytic capacitor, down to pin one.

scenes.heading: The light, onto the third resistor
scenes.narration: The light goes on next. Its anode is laid along the upturned end of the third resistor, and {soldered|soddered}.

scenes.heading: Ground: the light to pin 1
scenes.narration: A last ground jumper joins the cathode of the light to pin one.

scenes.heading: The battery snap, and pin 8
scenes.narration: Last, the battery snap. The arm sets it flat on the turntable, beside the vise. A jumper rises from its first {lead|leed}, past the jaw, to pin eight, the supply.

scenes.heading: The battery to pin 1
scenes.narration: The other {lead|leed} gets a jumper to pin one, the ground. Each end is pinched, {soldered|soddered}, cooled, and inspected.

scenes.heading: Checked against the netlist
scenes.narration: Finally, the cell inspects for shorts, and checks the work against the netlist. Seven of seven nets are made. Nothing is damaged.
